content: Swelling index may refer to the following material parameters that quantify volume change:
<info> Crucible swelling index, also known as free swelling index, in coal assay
<info> Swelling capacity, the amount of a liquid that can be absorbed by a polymer
<info> Unload-reload constant (κ) in critical state soil mechanics
